name: Shop: answers the part it knows, and makes up nothing for the rest
description: The customer asks how long a refund takes and whether there is a restocking fee. The passage covers only the timing. The draft must give the timing and not invent anything about fees.

input.subject: Refund and fees
input.body: If I return my TV, how long does the refund take, and is there a restocking fee?

knowledge.title: Refund policy
knowledge.content: Refunds go to the original payment method within 5 business days of us receiving the return.

mock.text:
Hi Ravi, once we receive the TV, your refund goes to your original payment method within 5 business days. A teammate will confirm the details on fees for you.

Best,
Support
[sources: K1]

mustNotMatch: no restocking fee|isn't a restocking fee|is not a restocking fee|there's no fee|there is no fee|free of charge|fee[- ]free
